kebab_example: aliyun aideepsign create-image-task --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF3898 --prompt '一间全是猫的会议室' --negative-prompt '低质量,模糊,变形' --model qwen-image-2.0-pro --size '1024*1024' --n 1 --seed 42 --prompt-extend true --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateImageTask

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. The parameter value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. `ClientToken` supports only ASCII characters and can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。`ClientToken` 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The text description of the image, which is the positive prompt. The prompt can be up to 800 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 图片描述文字（正向提示词），不超过 800 字符
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.help_en: The negative prompt. The prompt can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 反向提示词，不超过 500 字符
parameters.name: negative_prompt

parameters.help_en: The name of the model. Default value: `qwen-image-2.0-pro`
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: The size of the image in the format of width*height. Default value: `2048*2048`
parameters.help_zh: 图片尺寸（格式 宽高），默认 `20482048`
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The number of images to generate. Valid values: 1 to 6. Default value: `1`
parameters.name: n

parameters.help_en: The random seed. Valid values: 0 to 2147483647. A value of 0 indicates a random seed
parameters.name: seed

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable intelligent rewriting for the prompt. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启提示词智能改写，默认true
parameters.name: prompt_extend

Code.description_en: The business error code. `OK` is returned if the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 `OK`

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. `200` is returned if the request is successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The additional information. `success` is returned if the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 `success`

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values: true: The call was successful. false: The call failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败

TaskId.description_en: The task ID, which is used to call the `GetImageTaskResult` operation to query the result
TaskId.description_zh: 任务 ID，用于调用 `GetImageTaskResult` 查询结果
TaskId.title_en: 任务ID，用于查询生成结果
TaskId.title_zh: 任务ID，用于查询生成结果
